approval_sequence: Approve source-only implementation of the observable expert, same-input grid contract and E/C/P wrappers; this does not approve data/fits
Independent review, exact-zero/logit/value/hidden-state/serialization parity and resource qualification each need their registered scope
Approve bounded expert/dataset collection, then supervised proxy and evaluation packets separately; no S1 lease reset/retry implied

budgets.gate: Forecast all loops/raster/labels/I/O plus20% margin inside caps from separately authorized resource qualification. Refuse launch if infeasible; no implicit expansion of B5/A1 or held S1 disposition.
budgets.type: Proposed hard ceilings, not forecasts or authorization. Separate6GiB RSS/MPS, AC and one MPS job; exact-once/review/lease/parent gates unchanged.

dataset.history: All current arrays already include registered measured motion; expert gets no extra raw-frame/index history. Any extra temporal input must be provided to every arm and aligned with student history in a separate contract.
dataset.limits: The512 pool was used historically by420. Proxy holdout means no supervised fit seed leakage, not never-seen game seeds or independent teacher generalization.
dataset.sampling: Deterministic uniform reservoir of up to32 decision states/game, independent of labels/future outcomes. Preserve short episodes and actual counts; no replacement games. Freeze state/label manifest before fitting. No oracle branch data.
dataset.split_rule: Ascending actual pool seed order; both behavior episodes and all states from a seed stay in one split. Seed IDs are bookkeeping only, never model/expert inputs.
dataset.storage: Store original arrays once (~184.25MiB at32768 states excluding metadata); derive grid on demand. No image/simulator snapshot/native binary in tracked evidence.
dataset.weights: Equal episode weight then equal state weight within episode; all architectures receive identical ordered minibatches/labels and no extra information.

expert.gate: DODGE-045 found FullState ineligible. First implement/review and explicitly approve evaluation of a stateless12-frame public-physics predictor using exactly the four admitted arrays. No analytic native motion, raw pattern/type/timer lookup or engine-future rollout.
expert.labels: Deterministic chosen action with frozen tie-breaking from that observable expert only. Expert future-model scores are approximate predictions, never engine-oracle scores. No privileged action/value/auxiliary labels.
expert.qualification_cohort: first128 ascending consumed telemetry seeds; source/resource gates and explicit go-ahead required
expert.suitability: Report expert survival, class balance/tie rates and majority-action baseline. A weak/degenerate expert limits proxy interpretation; never fix it silently after seeing proxy results.

fits.capacity_rule: Gated128->h->128 latent MLP, no grid. These are additional separately approved fits/evaluations before attributing gains to spatial bias rather than capacity. Full-width scratch study is also separate; warm proxy does not settle scratch PPO architecture ranking.
fits.initialization: Same420 encoder/actor weights in each arm; new branch RNG isolated and gates0. All use fresh Adam, freeze critic head and no value/auxiliary/PPO loss. This is supervised warm-start adaptation, not an efficacy PPO run.
fits.limits: Up to20 fixed-data epochs or2000 optimizer steps, whichever first; same example passes across arms.20min work+2min receipts per fit, no silent truncation/retry.
fits.objective: Hard-label cross entropy to observable expert action. No smoothing/oracle sharpening. This deliberately tests an imitation proxy; successful hard-label fitting does not qualify the resulting soft teacher.
fits.optimizer: Proposed Adam1e-4, eps1e-5, batch512, gradient clip0.5; no LR/entropy-schedule sweep in this proxy. Exact fit seed vectors must be frozen after source approval.
fits.selection: Predeclare validation CE endpoint selection; retain terminal and selected endpoints. Never choose architecture/checkpoint using test or survival then call the same data confirmation.
fits.value_limit: The critic head is frozen but encoder adaptation can change its values. No value-distillation targets or critic-quality claim may come from this actor-only proxy; later value training/validation is separately gated.

metrics.interpretation: Telemetry cohort is already consumed/exposed development. Proxy loss and even development survival cannot authorize the full-send entry, unseen-seed claims, promotion or PPO improvement claims. No new cohort is opened here.
offline: action agreement and macro-F1/class counts versus majority baseline
fit/data efficiency at common passes and wall time
per-episode mean loss and seed-cluster bootstrap
parameter/MAC count, measured component throughput/RSS/MPS when approved
metrics.robustness: P6 standing noise supplement:4 perturbations x256 fixed subset seeds x8 models x2 rates =16384 additional games; compare with clean subset rows. Intended/selected/executed switches and entropy/soft-label metrics remain required.
metrics.survival: After strict fit/eval acceptance, evaluate6 preregistered validation-selected models plus420 and observable expert on1024 consumed telemetry seeds at K1 andK4:16384 clean games. Report separately sorted marginal Q1/Q4, Mean/Worst/Best/milestones; all training replicas separate.

primary_grid.expanded_visible_followup: A later same-C-architecture capped-grid versus full-visible-grid contrast can isolate added visible information separately from spatial bias. Full-visible geometry/warnings/measured motion need their own renderer/provenance audit, capture/labeler contract and counted budget; no hidden FullState fields or automatic use of raw auxiliary targets.
primary_grid.geometry: Canonical16x16 grid has8-pixel cells on128x128 world, unlike planned student8x8 grid of16-pixel patches. Reuse half-open/point/inverted-box and drawn-warning raster conventions, but primary input has no extra warning geometry. Float-array decoding is not exact fixed-point geometry; freeze edge conventions and parity fixtures before implementation.
primary_grid.later: Wall/clearance/free-space channels require separately specified deterministic derivations. No hidden timers, offscreen hidden geometry, RNG or pattern IDs. Expanded full-visible grid is separate, not silently mixed into C/P.
primary_grid.overlap: Velocity/count use enemy-family types1..3 and footprint-overlap cells. Equal-weight mean over contributing tokens; empty cells0. Opposing flows can cancel. Unknown measured zero remains ambiguous; never import hidden history-valid flags or analytic velocity.
primary_grid.semantics: lethal_soon_observed12 is a versioned estimate, not an exact copy of native charging/warning channel or true future. No full-list overflow recovery. Empty/known-free cells are not a safety guarantee.
primary_grid.source: Pure function of global_feats/entity_feats/entity_types/entity_mask and registered public physics; sanitize padding exactly as baseline.
